Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Did he ? Gah, I feel like I am repeating myself.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: What if I called you ... Fennish Human ? Or Danish Human, even though you are neither ?

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Him saying that does not change la réalité. I have been French Kweebec toute ma vie, not whatever autre nom he decides to assign to me.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I have been trying to be authentique with you. I can guarantee you that : it is not my intention to hide behind lies, or whatever he might say.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Now, I must go wash off that ... ideé from mon esprit.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Ah, I have not had escargot in some time. Do the Québécois know how to make *that* ? Non !

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He scampers off towards his home, leaving you in the proverbial dust to ponder upon what happened -- and to be so grossed out from learning his snail-eating habits that you vow never to visit him again. What's next? Sautéed magma toads?

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Well, it looks like he couldn't admit to it. You messed up at some point, whether by teasing him too hard or playing along with his complex. He's now firmly rooted in his dubious Frenchness.

Line.Text: And you probably pushed him into eating snails so that he proves himself. Congratulations. You lost.

Actions.Title: Uh-oh
Actions.Message: Something clearly went wrong. Maybe you shouldn't enable his 'Frenchness' too much.
